First release under the name `quantowl`, formerly `finlab`: a Python toolkit for the methods in Marcos López de Prado's *Advances in Financial Machine Learning*. To move over, run `pip uninstall finlab`, install quantowl, and replace `finlab` with `quantowl` in imports and `finlab-mcp` with `quantowl-mcp`. The full changelog is in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/landtml/quantowl/blob/v0.1.6/CHANGELOG.md).

## Install

```bash
pip install "git+https://github.com/landtml/quantowl@v0.1.6"
# with plotting and the example notebooks
pip install "quantowl[plot,notebooks] @ git+https://github.com/landtml/quantowl@v0.1.6"
```

## Added

- `sadf_null_quantiles` (`quantowl.structural_breaks`): simulated critical values for `sadf` under a random-walk null, per end point and for the maximum over end points, reproducible by `seed`.
- `hrp_weights(cluster_on="distance_of_distances")` and `distance_of_distances`: clustering on the distance of distances, which reproduces the printed AFML Snippet 16.1. The default is unchanged.
- `SequentialBootstrapBagging` works with scikit-learn's `clone`, `cross_val_score` and `GridSearchCV` (`get_params`, `set_params`, `score`, classifier tag), without quantowl importing scikit-learn.
- A documentation site built from `docs/`, with a strict build on every pull request.
- `CITATION.cff`, so GitHub shows a "Cite this repository" box.

## Changed

- The package is renamed `quantowl`. There is no `finlab` module any more.
- `SequentialBootstrapBagging` checks its arguments in `fit`, and refuses a `t1` whose values are not datetimes or integer positions.

## Fixed

- `grid_search`, `randomized_search`, `mda`, `sfi` and `SequentialBootstrapBagging` pass `sample_weight` to a scikit-learn `Pipeline`'s final step (AFML Snippet 9.2), through nested Pipelines. A weighted Pipeline used to raise `ValueError`.
- `SequentialBootstrapBagging.predict_proba` averages over the fitted bags.

## Known limitations

See the [known limitations in CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/landtml/quantowl/blob/v0.1.6/CHANGELOG.md#016---2026-10-29).
